name: prose-lint
description: Runs the wording linters on a Japanese or English document and rules on every hit: textlint with Japanese and English configs, a register of rejected wordings that you grow row by row (including definition by negation), natural-japanese's lint with its naturalness score and baseline rerun, a sudachipy morphology lint (four checks from 公用文作成の考え方 and two house rules), and vale with proselint.
